title: Read performance before creating the preview, or tolerate a failed read.
comment:
**Read performance before creating the preview, or tolerate a failed read.**

`deps.preview` is a mutation. It creates evidence and an owner preview link. `readExperiencePerformance` runs after it and can throw:
- `STALE_SOURCE` when the report schema or digest does not match.
- `NOT_FOUND` when the artifact row is missing.

In either case, the dispatcher returns an error to the caller even though the preview already exists. The caller loses the `evidenceId` and `previewUrl`.

This contradicts the intended diagnostic-only role of the summary ("keeps preview available as a diagnostic"). Move the performance read before `deps.preview`. Authorization and build-visibility failures then surface before the mutation runs.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-      const preview = await deps.preview(ctx, input);
       const performance = await readExperiencePerformance(
         ctx,
         input.buildId,
         deps.readPerformance,
         'storefront.write'
       );
+      const preview = await deps.preview(ctx, input);
```
</details>

title: Align the route pattern with the schema route contract.
comment:
**Align the route pattern with the schema route contract.**

The schemas accept different routes than the qualifier:

- `experiencePerformanceReport.samples[].route` and `canonicalRoutePath` in `experience-performance-worker.ts` accept routes of 1–240 characters.
- `performance-harness.test.ts` asserts that a 240-character canonical path is the "maximum supported" input.
- The qualifier pattern `^\/(?!\/)[^\s]{0,238}$` allows only 239 characters and also rejects whitespace.

A build with a 240-character route, or a route that contains whitespace, gets all 12 samples measured and retained. It then always fails with `route-matrix-mismatch`. Publication of that build is therefore blocked. Use the same length bound and character rule in all three places, preferably through one shared constant.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-        typeof route !== 'string' || !/^\/(?!\/)[^\s]{0,238}$/.test(route)
+        typeof route !== 'string' ||
+        route.length > 240 ||
+        !/^\/(?!\/)/.test(route)
```
</details>
